activity.notes: Itamar Franco assumed the presidency in an acting capacity on 2 October 1992 during Fernando Collor's impeachment proceedings. His acting phase ended when he was formally installed as President on 29 December 1992.

sources.title: Itamar Augusto Cautiero Franco — Arquivo Nacional
sources.citation_text: Brazil's National Archive gives Itamar Franco's presidential period as 2 October 1992 to 1 January 1995.

sources.title: Biografia — Itamar Franco — Secretaria-Geral
sources.citation_text: The Brazilian federal government states that Itamar became acting president on 2 October 1992 and was formally installed as president on 29 December 1992 after Collor's resignation.
